'''Malita Tal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]].

==History==
A holoperformer from a young age, Malita Tal was already an idol as a teenager, and her fame only increased with [[Time/Legends|time]]. Her [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] performances were watched by millions, while her humanitarian and environmental work inspired her most devoted fans. The [[Malita Tal Environmentalism Award]] for preserving and restoring natural ecosystems of Zakuul was created in her honor. Following the [[assassination of Valkorion]] in [[3636 BBY]], his son [[Arcann]] took the throne. Malita was one of the first on Zakuul to loudly question his rule. Her fans organized a protest against Arcann and soon evidence of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] correspondence in her personal holoterminal was discovered by Zakuul officials, who may have planted the evidence themselves. Malita was forced to flee Zakuul and go into exile on suspicion of [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. Her flight divided her fanbase. Some ruled her a traitor, while others hoped she would come back.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Malita Tal'}}</ref>

[[File:Malita_Tal_captured.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Malita Tal as a prisoner on the Eternal Fleet warship]]
In [[3631 BBY]] an [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] was formed against Arcann from former Republic and Imperial forces. Malita and others wanted to join, but its location was well hidden. Eventually she found [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator]] [[Tai Cordan]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] Admiral [[Zasha Ranken]], the three of them decided to start an Alliance of their own. However, they were soon found out and captured. En route to Zakuul, the [[Eternal Fleet warship]] that was transporting them was [[GEMINI trap|boarded]] in [[3630 BBY]] by Alliance forces consisting of [[Senya Tirall]], [[Lana Beniko]], [[Theron Shan]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Alliance Commander]]. They found and released the prisoners, but on their way to the escape pods the [[GEMINI]] captain of the vessel initiated the self-destruct sequence. Tal and her bodyguards were trapped in the escape pod that would not launch, just like the other two groups. Theron Shan was able to launch two of three pods remotely, before the remaining one exploded, killing everyone on board.

==Behind the scenes==
{{GameLS}}
{{Quote|Malita. My people. They're... they're dead.|Senya Tirall mourns for Malita if the player is unable to save her|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
Malita Tal appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 15: The GEMINI Deception'''. The player has to choose the order of saving Malita, Ranken or Cordan. The first two persons picked survive and escape to join the Alliance, while the last one dies. Neither choice is a Light or Dark Side option. If she's the one left to die, Senya will be displeased.
